notes: S1 keeps Datum's four stations unchanged. Two stand inside buildings at the 24 m concourse: circus in signatures/space-hq and skyport in megastructures/skyport-tower.
Not verified: I had no plan checker in this run, so nothing below is checker output. The figures are hand arithmetic from the passages.
S-S2 spacing along the trunk: gardens to circus 255 m, circus to harbour 245 m, harbour to skyport 205 m. All sit inside the 200-500 band; skyport cannot move west without squeezing the 205.
Crown Circus banks: towers and lifts at 7.75-14.75 m off the line fit the ground hall between the 4 m hall lane and the legs at y ±20. They land on the Parade mall, not a plot.

Harbour banks land on the pier causeway quay (y ±25). Skyport banks land on the apron quay (y ±40), between the tower legs. Sphere Gardens uses the two open forecourt plots beside Circus Road's 6 m median.
No third in-building station is possible: parade-gate is a running portal (clear half-width 6), and a station needs 16. I did not ask Datum to widen it.

Interchange T2/harbour is carried from the candidate, but the passages name only tram T1 and call Crown Circus 'the one interchange'. Tram stops were not shown, so I could not check it or the 150 m limit.
N-R1 reach (250 m) also depends on the tram stops, which are outside this run. I did not judge it; no sky station was moved, so the sky rail's share is unchanged.
